Each item is one session's usage in one daily billing window. Items are
ordered by billing date and session. Only session-days with a usage record
are returned; recorded zero-ACU days may be present. Sum items by
`session_id` for per-session totals. `first` counts session-days.

sealed and hidden-from-team sessions and sessions without an organization,

UTC date of `time_after` are omitted; partial days are not prorated. Use
08:00 UTC bounds for complete billing days (fixed UTC-8, including summer).

correction feed. `total` is not computed.

  commit builds and their GitHub check runs. Root blueprints of
